text:
That clock, which a sovereign hand
sealed as a sign, though it was a gift,
and made the benefit more binding than law,
sparing the clamor of a bell;


that chain which, in no vain workmanship,
halts Time in his revolving task,
reducing him to eternal sacrifice
(due pomp for one who rose beyond the human):


it is a great honor, a shining atom,
of Leonor's ingenious sun,
which spreads to Spain from Hungary,


that but one life was allotted to you,
short, Fabio, beside so weighty a favor,
and grants you time in which to be grateful.

translation.title: That Clock a Sovereign Hand
